lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Is this Commander {AccountData.NickName}'s number?
Viper?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: It is you! I got it right!
How did you get my number?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I did my research ;)

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I just wanted to say hi

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: and wanted to talk about some personal stuff as well♡
What do you mean by "personal"?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Oh, you know...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: There's something I wanted to ask.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: No, that's not right.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I have a bunch of questions I want to ask!
What do you want to know?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: No beating around the bush with you, I see!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Just stuff like... what are your hobbies?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What's your favorite food?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What turns you on? What turns you off?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Stuff like that.
This is starting to feel like an interview.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I suppose you could say that♡

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Unlike everyone else,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'm usually in the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: So I can't see you very often :'(

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'd rather talk to you in person, but since I can't,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'll just have to send you messages here.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: It's the only way I can get closer to you.
Why do you want to get closer to me?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: C'mon, don't be a stranger!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'm one of your Nikkes now, Honey♡
That name sounds... off.
Honey?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: What? Don't you like it?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I was just teasing, but you reacting like that

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: makes me want to use it for real.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Anyhoo, if you're ever curious about anything, send me a message, Honey.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: If you want to meet in person, even better :D
Okay.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Until next time!
